subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】thin 瘦的; fat 胖的; tall 高的; short 矮的/短的; long 长的; small 小的; big 大的; giraffe 长颈鹿; deer 鹿; tail 尾巴
【重点句型】Look at that ... 看那…… It's (so) tall/fat ... 它（真）高/胖…… It has ... 它有…… It is short and fat. 它又矮又胖。 It has a long nose. 它有长鼻子。
【A Let's talk】Miss White: Look at that monkey. Amy: It's fat! Zhang Peng: Look at that giraffe. It's so tall! Miss White: It's tall and thin.
【Read and write】Look at the elephant. It has a long nose. Look at the panda. It's fat and short. Look at the giraffe. It's tall. Look at the deer. It's short. Look at the monkey. It's small.
key_points: It is short and fat. 它又矮又胖。
It has a long nose. 它有长鼻子。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
